[PATH:theoretical] Theoretical analysis of computational capacity and sample efficiency bounds for transformer versus non-transformer architectures (e.g., studies on expressivity of attention mechanisms vs. recurrent or graph-based computation) — If non-transformer architectures are proven to have strictly greater expressivity or better inductive biases for key AGI capabilities (e.g., handling of long-range dependencies, dynamic memory, or online learning) under realistic constraints, this would provide strong theoretical evidence for the hypothesis; otherwise, theoretical limitations may refute it.
